\section{Functional Test Cases}\label{sec:cases}
One subsection per feature of SRS Section~4, in the same order. Each opens with what the feature's test cases establish; every test case uses the template of Section~\ref{sec:conventions}, starts from the test world of Section~\ref{sec:world} after a reset, and uses the dates of Section~\ref{sec:dates} and the Quotes of Table~\ref{tab:quotes}. Requests named in preconditions, such as ``Request A1'', are created by the Actor named there through the Draft editor and submitted before step~1.

This edition holds the 63 High priority test cases and the 5 Low priority cases of the Stretch requirements; together they cover every requirement, as Appendix~\ref{app:trace} shows. The 23 Medium priority cases, which check secondary rules and refusals, are kept in the full edition. Test cases keep the numbers they have there, so the numbers below skip those cases, and each subsection ends with a list of the ones it leaves out.
